# GSTBro

## Core GST Services

- [GST Registration](https://gstbro.com/services/gst-registration): Fast-track online GSTIN registration (REG-01) with CA document vetting.
- [GST Return Filing](https://gstbro.com/services/gst-returns): Monthly & quarterly GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, and QRMP/IFF filing with 100% Zero-Penalty SLA.
- [GST Compliance & 2B ITC Reconciliation](https://gstbro.com/services/gst-compliance): Automated GSTR-2B purchase reconciliation, Rule 88A offset optimization, and vendor follow-ups.
- [GST Audit & Annual Return](https://gstbro.com/services/gst-audit): GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C reconciliation and statutory audit support.
- [GST Notice Defense & Advisory](https://gstbro.com/services/gst-advisory): Senior CA representation for ASMT-10, DRC-01, and show-cause notices.
- [GST Refund Claims](https://gstbro.com/services/gst-refund): RFD-01 export, LUT, and inverted duty structure refund processing.
- [GST TDS & TCS](https://gstbro.com/services/gst-tds-tcs): GSTR-7 & GSTR-8 compliance for e-commerce operators and government deductors.
- [GST Cancellation & Revocation](https://gstbro.com/services/gst-cancellation): REG-16 surrender, GSTR-10 final return, and REG-21 revocation.

## Business Licenses & Tools

- [Business Licenses Hub](https://gstbro.com/services/business-licenses): Shop & Establishment, Trade License, FSSAI, MSME Udyam, IEC, Professional Tax, Class 3 DSC, and Startup India DPIIT.
- [GST Calculators & Resources](https://gstbro.com/resources): Free GST Calculator (forward & reverse), GST Late Fee & Section 50 Interest Calculator, and GST TDS/TCS Calculator.
- [HSN & SAC Code Search](https://gstbro.com/hsn-sac-search): Search Indian HSN codes (goods) and SAC codes (services) with prevailing 2026 GST 2.0 tax rates (0%, 3%, 5%, 18%, 40%).
- [Transparent Pricing](https://gstbro.com/pricing): Retainer plans for startups, MSMEs, e-commerce sellers, and enterprises.
- [About GSTBro](https://gstbro.com/about): Institutional tax governance and ICAI-supervised practice overview.
- [Contact & Consultation](https://gstbro.com/contact): Book a 15-minute CA GST strategy call.
